brief:
The Palestinian Meteorology Department predicted Thursday's weather would be hot in mountainous areas and extremely hot in other regions, Shehab Wire reported. Humidity levels are expected to rise across Palestinian territories.

Temperatures will decline from current levels but remain elevated for the season, according to the meteorological forecast. The department did not specify the duration of the expected temperature drop or when conditions might shift.
